title: Adding fancy French ingredients to my AI cooking game.
author: VirtualJamesHarrison
selftext:
Over 70,000 ingredients now discovered  
Play for free at [https://infinite-kitchen.com/kitchen](https://infinite-kitchen.com/kitchen)

comments.author: VanillaMammoth1937
comments.body: I like the visuals, it looks relaxing. Did you AI generate the art, or did you get it from somewhere?

replies.author: VirtualJamesHarrison
replies.body: Everything is generated, but I have a human review stuff so i check everything and tweak it for the more popular items and tools.

replies.author: VanillaMammoth1937
replies.body: Just wondering, which image generator did you use? I'm wondering because I also have a game in progress where I need to generate a ton of assets in the same art style, and I'm having a hard time having Nano Banana keep the style consistent.

replies.author: VirtualJamesHarrison
replies.body:
Flux 2 series is good for this i am finding.  
I use Flux 2 Klein first then if an ingredient is getting used a lot I upgrade it too Flux 2 pro for better quality.

comments.author: monsterfurby
comments.body: Okay, this is pretty cool, love it. I wonder though if there is really no vinegar or if I'm just blind.
